definition: Agent experience (AX) is the design of digital environments in which AI agents can understand, navigate, and act effectively.
details: The term can also refer to the appearance and affordances of an environment from a machine-user's point of view. In other words, the experience AI agents have as users of platforms and products; in this sense it has a close parallel with user experience (UX). Less often, the term spans the experience of collaborating with AI agents from the human perspective.
